title: Edit a Notion report: add a filter and a body field

conversation.text: Change my Notion done pages report: also require Priority (a select property) to be High, and add url (the page URL) to the JSON body of the POST. Keep everything else as it is.

source.note: Synthetic seed: the workflow that the node contracts build saves for nc-notion-filter-and-read, with contract node types.

description: Edit round trip for node contracts. The seed is the saved Notion done pages workflow with contract node types, so the node contracts arm reads it back with get-as-code and edits it in the typed format. The live turn adds a fourth filter condition on a select property and a new POST body field. Run it on the node contracts arm only: an instance without the flag does not load the contract node types.

executionScenarios.name: added-filter-and-field
executionScenarios.description: The query carries the three seeded conditions plus Priority, and the POSTs carry the new url field.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The Notion API data source query (POST /v1/data_sources/5b9e2c1d-0a7f-4c3e-9d21-7f6a8b9c0d1e/query) returns { "object": "list", "has_more": false, "next_cursor": null, "results": [{"object": "page", "id": "1f2a3b4c-5d6e-7f80-9123-456789abcdef", "url": "https://www.notion.so/1f2a3b4c5d6e7f809123456789abcdef", "properties": {"Name": {"id": "title", "type": "title", "title": [{"type": "text", "plain_text": "Ship billing v3", "text": {"content": "Ship billing v3"}}]}, "Status": {"id": "s", "type": "status", "status": {"name": "Done"}}, "Priority": {"id": "p", "type": "select", "select": {"name": "High"}}, "Completed": {"id": "c", "type": "date", "date": {"start": "2026-09-10", "end": null, "time_zone": null}}, "Owners": {"id": "o", "type": "people", "people": [{"object": "user", "id": "7c3e1a2b-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d", "name": "Dana Scully", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "dana@acme.test"}}]}}}] }. Return these raw API objects unchanged. The reports endpoint returns 200 { "ok": true } for any POST.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The Notion query filter ANDs Status status equals Done, Completed date on_or_after 2026-09-01, Owners people contains 7c3e1a2b-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d, and Priority select equals High. The POST carries name 'Ship billing v3', owners 'dana@acme.test', completed '2026-09-10', and url 'https://www.notion.so/1f2a3b4c5d6e7f809123456789abcdef'. A dropped seeded condition or field FAILS.

outcomeExpectations: The Notion node keeps the three seeded conditions and adds Priority select equals High, all combined with AND.
The POST body keeps name, owners and completed, and adds url from the page URL.
The edited workflow keeps the contract Notion and HTTP Request node types (@n8n/nodes-integrations and @n8n/nodes-core).
